lastCompletedStory.title: Name the exhausted budget on the escalation marker and event

nextStoryContext: PlanEscalatedMarker (src/supervisor/plan-escalation.ts) and PlanEscalatedEventDetail (src/supervisor/events.ts) now both carry exhaustedBudget: 'oracle-lint' | 'auditor', set from the terminal audit-blocked result's own `origin` field (the same discriminator US-002 introduced for the independent lint/auditor round budgets) at both write sites in runPlanPhaseWithReplan (src/supervisor/plan-runner.ts): the writeMarker({...}) call and the planOpts.logEvent?.({ kind: 'plan-escalated', detail: {...} }) call. On PlanEscalatedMarker the field is optional (`exhaustedBudget?:`) purely at the READ boundary (readPlanEscalatedMarker's shape guard treats it as optional, silently dropping an invalid/wrong-type value rather than rejecting the whole marker) so a marker written by a pre-US-003 binary still round-trips; the WRITE side (writeMarker call in plan-runner.ts) always supplies it -- there is no code path that omits it going forward. On PlanEscalatedEventDetail the field is REQUIRED (no backward-compat concern: events are transient flight-recorder entries, never read back across a binary upgrade the way the durable marker is). Two existing plan-runner-replan.test.ts assertions that pinned the marker/event payload with toEqual({...}) (an exact-shape assertion, GOTCHA called out in this story's own PRD notes) had to gain the new field rather than being left to silently under-assert; the same care applies to ANY future field added to either type -- grep for `toEqual(` against the marker/event shape before adding a field, don't just add it and let tests happen to still pass. sidecar.ts's makeWriteEscalationMarkerFn needed NO change: it spreads `...params` from PlanEscalationWriterParams (Omit<PlanEscalatedMarker, 'writtenAt'>) into the full marker, so a new optional field on PlanEscalatedMarker flows through for free -- always check for a spread-through seam like this before assuming a threading story needs a production-wiring-file edit.
